description: This file implements the DateCalculationEngine class, providing methods for date arithmetic such as adding/subtracting durations and calculating date differences, with special handling for Japanese calendar systems.

classes.name: DateCalculationEngine
classes.description: A class providing date arithmetic operations including adding/subtracting durations and calculating differences, with special handling for Japanese calendar systems.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for DateDifference objects, compares year, month, week, and day fields.

methods.name: DateCalculationEngine::AddDuration
methods.description: Adds a specified duration to a start date, handling Japanese calendar system conversions.

methods.name: DateCalculationEngine::SubtractDuration
methods.description: Subtracts a specified duration from a start date, handling Japanese calendar system conversions.

methods.name: DateCalculationEngine::TryGetDateDifference
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two dates in terms of years, months, weeks, and days.
